name: steering-audit-suite
description: Agent Skills that audit the documents prescribing agent behaviour: audit-rule for always-on rules (CLAUDE.md, steering files, system prompts), audit-skill for invocable skills, audit-workflow for multi-step procedures, audit-collection for a directory of documents, and rule-audit, the standalone single-file form. They run 15 checks, compare with vendor-published exemplars, and report findings for the document's owner without rewriting anything. The main skill classifies and routes a document.
